text:
Elaine (Partnerships): FYI OrbitCloud just sent a late manifest update — 12 racks shifted, 4 SKUs swapped. This collides with our Dedicated reservations for APAC starting next week. Need quick decision on mitigation.

Sara (Supply Chain): Ugh. Which reservations exactly?

Elaine (Partnerships): Reservation IDs: 
```
resv-2025-APAC-7782
resv-2025-APAC-7783
resv-2025-APAC-7790
```
They flagged ETA change to 2025-06-12 (was 2025-05-22). Partner email pasted below.

Devon (Ops): That pushes us past the customer's requested start window. Can we spill to US-West warm pool temporarily? Latency for NovaCorp is risky but might be tolerable for Acme depending on config.

Anita (Sales): I need a clear customer impact statement to tell account teams. @Elaine can you confirm which customers will see SLA violations if we don't deliver APAC racks by original date?

Elaine (Partnerships): Acme (high-sensitivity low-latency) and NovaCorp (batch inference, more tolerant). Acme would see >60ms added tail latency if routed to US-West. That likely counts as SLO miss for their contract.

Sara (Supply Chain): Partner offers an SKU swap: ship A10x instead of A100 for 8 racks, rest delayed. Performance delta ~30% single-thread but we could repartition workloads. Not ideal for Acme.

Devon (Ops): Quick inventory check command: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://inventory.redwood.internal/api/v1/sku?region=us-west,apac&model=A10x,A100"
```
I'll run now and report back.

Orion Bot: Inventory query queued (job 4427). Results in ~2m.

Anita (Sales): If we can't keep Acme latency, we should offer credit + temporary routing to US-West while we expedite. I'll draft comms. Do we have a commercial playbook for expedited shipments?

Sara (Supply Chain): We do but it requires partner confirmation and a paid expedite fee. ETA after expedite ~2025-05-29 vs partner's standard 2025-06-12.

Elaine (Partnerships): Okay options on the table: 1) Accept A10x swap and repartition (risk Acme churn), 2) Reroute Acme to US-West temporarily + credit + expedite APAC for long term, 3) Pause rollouts for Acme and NovaCorp (bad UX). Need decision by EOD to lock marketplace swaps.

Devon (Ops): If we reroute, I'll need a canary routing plan and runbook update. Estimated 3 hours of ops work. I can prep the PR for routing policy change once inventory/availability confirmed.

Sara (Supply Chain): Inventory job complete: 6 A100-equivalent GPUs available in US-West warm pool, 0 in APAC immediate. Marketplace partner (ByteCloud) can supply 10 units in APAC but requires marketplace contract sign-off. Link: https://contracts.bytecloud/quote/RED-2035

Anita (Sales): I'm going to call OrbitCloud AE and propose paid expedite for the remaining racks and ask for formal credit for the swap. I'll also loop legal if marketplace contract needs sign-off today.

Elaine (Partnerships): Good. Action items: 
- Sara: lock 6 GPUs in US-West warm pool (temp)
- Devon: prepare routing canary + ops ticket (#ops-5588)
- Anita: escalate to OrbitCloud AE and get expedite commitment / contract link
- Elaine: draft customer comms for Acme + NovaCorp

Devon (Ops): Opening ops ticket now: OPS-5588 — will attach canary plan.

Orion Bot: Ticket OPS-5588 created by Devon (Ops).

Anita (Sales): OrbitCloud AE confirmed expedited manifest is possible for a fee, ETA 2025-05-29 if we pay. AE also offered temporary loaner racks for 1 week at no charge — pending logistics.

Elaine (Partnerships): Great — let's go with route 2 (reroute + expedite). Sara please lock the US-West capacity and accept the temporary loaners if logistics allow. Devon, proceed with canary. Anita, coordinate purchase order for expedite. I'll prep customer comms and loop legal.

Sara (Supply Chain): Locking US-West now. Confirmed hold on 6 GPUs. I'll accept loaner offer pending shipping manifest.

Devon (Ops): Canary plan in OPS-5588. Will schedule the rollout for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Anita (Sales): PO submitted for expedite. AE asked for signed SOW amendment; I've uploaded to our drive: https://redwood.app/drive/expedite-sow

Elaine (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. We'll review after the canary. If expedite or loaner falls through we'll revisit options 1/3. :thumbsup:
